name: Balance for Extra Ammo For Everyone (Vanilla)
teaser: Like Extra Ammo? Seems like it does weird stuff? No more!
license_name: University of Illinois/NCSA Open Source License
description_html:
This is a release of my personal patch for Extra Ammo For Everyone by Sanote and friends. This is only for the vanilla version. I don’t touch realism.

I noticed the Damage, Pen, and Armor damage values in the original mod are decently off from BSG’s values so I changed those values to give a decent spread of usable ammo across the board and be more in line with logical conclusions and my own knowledge of ballistics.
